title: Definition
text: $$sin\left(\frac{3\pi}{4}\right)$$ is the y-coordinate of the point on the circle that lies along the circumference corresponding to the angle measure $$\frac{3\pi}{4}$$.\n##figure4.gif##

title: Coordinate
text: The point on the unit circle with angle $$\frac{3\pi}{4}$$ is in the second quadrant. Thus, the y-coordinate is positive and equal in absolute value to the absolute value of the x-coordinate; so it is $$\frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}$$.\n##figure5.gif##
